name: Bulk Create General Ledger Accounts
description: Create General Ledger Account in bulk

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of General Ledger account objects

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual gl account in the bulk-creation of gl accounts.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The user-provided name of the general ledger account. This name must be unique, no duplicate record is allowed.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: The account type or category of the GL account. Valid values include asset capital cash expense income liability other_expense or other_income.

attributes.name: Number
attributes.description: The user-provided number of the general ledger account. This number must be unique, no duplicate record is allowed.

attributes.name: FundAccount
attributes.description: The type of fund account. Options: Reserve (funds set aside for specific future purposes), Operating (funds set aside for regular operating expenses)

attributes.name: OffsetAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the offset account

attributes.name: ParentGlAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the parent general ledger account. If present, it indicates the parent account to which the sub-account belongs.

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the async job. Can be used to track the status of the job via the Jobs List endpoint.
